[[File:Fever spider icon.png|left]]
'''Fever spiders''' are monsters that require level 42 [[Slayer]] to kill. They are found in the brewery basement on [[Braindeath Island]] and can be accessed by going down the ladder in the northwest corner. Players must wear [[Slayer gloves]] while fighting them, or face being hit 12.5% of their maximum life points repeatedly. Fever spiders are a relatively fast task due to the large quantity of spiders, their low defence and lack of drops.
